description.mn: Acqua di Parma Camelia: Unisex цэцэгсийн үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: бергамот, мандарин, ягаан чинжүү, кардамон; зүрхний ноот: камелия, жасмин, мускат хашхираа; суурь ноот: заар, бензойн.
description.en: Camelia Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Camelia Eau de Parfum was launched in 2019. Top notes are Calabrian bergamot, Yellow Mandarin, Pink Pepper and Cardamom; middle notes are Camelia, Jasmine Sambac and Clary Sage; base notes are Musk and Benzoin.
